The tonic gRPC framework at /app/src/ provides a layered architecture for building high-performance RPC services. Your task is to extend the service layer with a metadata validation middleware that enforces constraints on incoming gRPC request metadata prior to the request reaching the handler.

Implement a MetadataValidator trait in tonic/src/service/metadata_validator.rs with a validate method that receives a reference to a MetadataMap and returns a Result containing either unit on success or Status on failure. Provide a ValidatorBuilder struct that allows composing validation rules through a fluent API with methods require_header, max_header_size, header_prefix, and max_total_headers. The header_prefix method takes a header name and prefix string, using starts_with for prefix matching and returning invalid_argument. Expose a MetadataValidatorLayer type that wraps any tower Service and applies the validator prior to forwarding requests. Wire the module into tonic/src/service/mod.rs with a public re-export. The existing interceptor tests and all other tests in the crate must continue passing with your changes.
